{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check number of unique patients after deduplication
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Apply the unit correction: assay_batch == 'B' values are in µg/L, must be divided by 10 to convert to ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ng_ml'] = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final values
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(num_patients)
print(mean_biomarker_final)"}
